messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Symptoms: increased 5xx, gateway timeouts, and client 504s. Alerting oncall Alex.

Alex: I see it — dashboard shows 5xx spike started ~3112233420, now at ~13% error rate and median latency doubled. Customers reporting failed requests.

Zoe: I'm on call with Alex. Can someone paste recent scheduler metrics (queue depth / avg batch size)?

Miguel: Pulling metrics now. queue_depth by host: gw-1: 420, gw-2: 410, batcher-0: 920, batcher-1: 870. avg_batch_size increased from 6 -> 20 in last 10m.

Lina: That avg_batch_size jump smells like runaway prefix aggregation + delayed KV cache hits. Head-of-line blocking is likely.

Jay: Support reports ~8 customers hit timeouts (3 major), sessions dropped and retry storms started. We should consider immediate mitigations for customer-facing services.

Alex: Triage plan: 1) mitigate customer impact 2) throttle noisy callers 3) reduce batch window / disable cross-model batching 4) fix root cause (investigate scheduler backlog).

Miguel: Quick mitigation options: - lower max_batch_size to 12 - reduce batch_window_ms from 50 -> 10 - enable preemptive eviction for long-waiting requests - route a % of traffic to fallback smaller model.

Zoe: Execute mitigations in order: reduce batch_window_ms first (lowest risk), then enable eviction. I'll coordinate.

Tanvi: I'll prepare status page blurb: "We are investigating elevated error rates for text generation in us-west-2; some requests may see 504s or increased latency." Any ETA?

Alex: No ETA yet. Post initial status now (Tanvi) with "investigating, mitigations in progress".

Miguel: Applying change: updating runtime config for batch_window_ms. Command: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/configs/runtime -d '{"batch_window_ms":10}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $SVC_TOKEN"
```

deploy-bot: config update queued; rollout 4/6 hosts succeeded, 2 pending.

Miguel: Patch rolled out to all batchers. Observing queue_depth dropping: batcher-0 -> 630, batcher-1 -> 580. avg_batch_size now ~10. Error rate down to 9%.

Alex: Good. Next enable eviction for requests waiting > 250ms. Miguel, apply eviction flag.

Miguel: Enabling preemptive-eviction (threshold_ms=250) now.

deploy-bot: feature flag toggled: preemptive-eviction=true (rollout 100%).

Miguel: After eviction, queue_depth: batcher-0 -> 380, batcher-1 -> 350. 5xx down to 5.6%, median latency back to baseline for successful calls.

Lina: We still see gateway 502 spikes on gw-2 correlated with one batcher host; investigating logs for OOM / thread exhaustion.

Zoe: Oncall handoff: Alex handing to Zoe for live mitigation while Alex focuses on customer comms. Alex -> Zoe: I'm leaving the room at 3112233520.

Alex: Sent update to customers and engineering slack. Notifying enterprise customers impacted and opening support bridge for engaged accounts.

Jay: Logged impacted customers and started 1:1 outreach for the three major accounts. Noted temporary credit offer if service interruption beyond 30m.

Miguel: Investigating batcher host bk-17: kernel logs show spikes in context-switches and a runaway python worker stuck on KV lookup. Restarting process on bk-17 now.

deploy-bot: restart job submitted for worker bk-17; restart completed. bk-17 back to normal.

Lina: gw-2 502s resolved after worker restart. Overall error rate now 2.1% and still trending down.

Zoe: Remaining actions: - run postmortem collection: scheduler traces, batcher logs, KV-cache latencies - add automatic throttle for callers making >X req/s - revisit batcher defaults to avoid huge avg_batch_size.

Miguel: Adding short-term sentinel: if avg_batch_size > 15 for >2m, trigger automatic batch_window_ms reduction and alert. I'll open PR after this.

Alex: Thanks team. I'll update incident record and schedule post-incident review. Leaving incident channel to Zoe (primary) and Miguel (runtime lead) for follow-ups.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: Resolved for now. Summary: batching/scheduler saturation + stalled worker caused head-of-line blocking and elevated 5xx/timeouts. Mitigations: reduced batch window, enabled preemptive eviction, restarted affected worker, temporary routing stable. Postmortem required.

Zoe: A few follow-ups assigned: Miguel (runtime fixes), Lina (traces + root cause), Jay (customer followups), Tanvi (status page close + timeline). I'll schedule triage sync in 40m. :thumbsup:
